items.creator: Helena Woods
items.title: People will try to put you in a box
items.summary:
People will try to put you in a box. They’ll categorize you based on your image. They’ll assume. They’ll fill in the blanks instead of curiously asking questions. 

Your job is to be…
uncontrollable. 

So much so that people regularly think, “who TF does this girl think she is?” 

They’ll get mad when they can’t control you. This is very very good. 😈 Because we’re here to do new things. We’re here to innovate and spark waves. 

When you don’t fit into what’s already available in the marketplace, you must find the audacity within you to make it yourself. 

You must build the thing that no one else dares to build. 

You must hold the vision before it’s real. 

Your job is to tame yourself enough to be laser focused on the goal in front of you but wild and unpredictable enough to never let the critics or the parents or the trolls know what you’re doing next 💨

Your job is to be so unwavering in your conviction of who you are and who you get to be and believe in what you can do more than anyone else. 

Your call is to explore your excitements until you find the calling that’s much bigger than you then the mission is to lead your life for something greater.

because only then will you have the consistent drive to leap out of bed each day and take action to make the world a brighter place. ☀️

You must be unyielding to those who tell you the dream is impossible or that you can’t have what you desire. 

You must ignore the circumstances and stop checking for anything outside of you. What “they” say. What “they” think. What “they” assume about you. 

This is being locked in. 

Self-concept is a powerful thing. ⚡️

Because when you believe in yourself and your mission more than anything else, it has something strong to latch onto. This will keep you steady when the external reality isn’t meeting your steadfast internal conviction. 

There will be failures. And flops. And haters. And slander. And low months, followed by boring months. That’s just the game 🎮

But can you stay devoted to the vision? 
The mission that’s bigger than you⚡️

items.title: Venus Retrograde in Scorpio in Birth Charts
items.summary:
A detailed exploration of what Venus retrograde in Scorpio means in birth charts, primarily by looking through 29 different celebrity case studies, with astrologers Skye Barclay and Chris Brennan.

During the episode, we examine not only how this placement manifests natally, but what happened when these figures experienced their 8-year Venus retrograde recurrences. By tracing these transits, we highlight the major turning points, delayed successes, and public reckonings that literally played out in their lives and careers in real time.

Our research uncovered some profound archetypal patterns surrounding what it means for a retrograde planet to be in its detriment. We dive deep into concepts like "struggle love," the "sympathetic villain," and the myths of Medusa and Lucifer, exploring how the individuals in our case studies challenged conventional beauty standards, subverted gender norms, and navigated the darker, more taboo facets of Venus.

Skye is the author of an awesome new book titled 2026 Venus Retrograde: A Dance of Daggers & Delights, which you can get in print or PDF on her website: 

https://www.skyeastrology.com/venusrx

This is episode 552 of The Astrology Podcast.
